profile.input: width 7, height 5 for 2D, 3 channels. One or two batches. GGML dimension 0 varies fastest.
profile.variant_bits: Bit 0 selects x stride 1 or 2. In 2D y stride equals 3 minus x stride. Bit 1 selects zero or one cell of padding on each active axis.
profile.im2col: Width 3, height 2 in 2D. Bit 2 selects x dilation 1 or 2, y dilation 1. Bit 3 selects batch count. Bit 4 selects kernel metadata F32 or F16. Call ggml_im2col_back with gradient first and kernel second, as in upstream autodiff.
profile.pool: 2 by 2 kernel. Bit 2 selects batch count. Bit 3 makes all original inputs equal to 1 to exercise max ties.
profile.values: Original F32 input at i = ((7*i)%23-11)/4 except for the pooling tie case. Incoming gradient at i = ((5*i)%17-8)/8. Prefill every output with 13.

checks.method: For every case, run the public forward and backward graph on the pinned CPU. Compare dot(forward(input), incoming_gradient) to dot(input, backward(incoming_gradient)) exactly in binary64.

transcript.columns: family variant followed by every output binary32 word in hexadecimal

VT-139.refusal_checks: Each restored provider graph rejects an extra source and zero x stride without changing output bytes.
VT-139.mutation: Clearing scratch accumulator 0 before each column-gradient instruction failed the exact output comparison. Restoring accumulation reproduced all 6,048 frozen words.
